original_request: Find a small car in San Francisco under $20,000. I drive short city trips and need it within two weeks.

preferences.criterion: Evidence of suitability for short city trips and easy parking

assumptions: Synthetic buyer confirmed that $20,000 is an advertised-price cap, excluding taxes and fees.
Synthetic buyer confirmed 2018 or newer and at most 60,000 miles during clarification.
Accident and title history may be unknown in search results and must be verified before purchase.
